verify: bundle exec rspec || bundle exec rake test

idioms: Rails projects: use rails generators and the client's existing concerns/service-object patterns.
Match the client's Ruby version from .ruby-version / Gemfile.
Use the client's test framework (RSpec vs Minitest) — detect from Gemfile groups.
Respect the client's .rubocop.yml exactly; don't fight their cops.
prompt_pack.pr_style: Match existing PR titles in the client repo. Default: imperative summary, link their issue.
never: Never run bundle update unless dependency updates ARE the task.
